name: s7-c3-fx
description: Sprint 7 recovery C3 combined native qualification: the effects phase only (summon-s7-effects) on the combined candidate. Covers the Ankylosaurus impact cue, the callback-loss observer with the declared two-source overlap (constructed setup) judged in game by C1's revised evaluator, the callback-abandoned, callback-setup-failed and trace-setup-failed drivers, the Dust cell with its pre-delivery command release and the Dust abandonment driver, all over the one cumulative isolation result. No other mods. The R6 Trumpet/Vrock launch is not affected by C3 and is not repeated.
